skill acquisition in lifelong robot learning with large language model about the phd project the integration of large language model llms into robot learning recently demonstrated remarkable success . it became possible to ground llms in the physical context and solve long horizon robotic task efficiently by querying llms to generate sequence of natural language command corresponding to pretrained skill that accomplish given task . llms have also enabled few shot adaptation to novel tool by generating task agnostic tool description for language conditioned learning of manipulation skills . long setting wherein task are sequentially presented to the robot without predefined task distribution . moreover the robot is expected to retain knowledge of previous task when learning new ones . this
